name: InBetween: Mee's Adventure
source:
You take the role of Mee, venturing into the Empty to investigate why the Eaters have vanished. Will you find a solution for your tribe, or encounter one of the many bits of Trouble? There are plenty of endings – both good and bad – waiting for you.

[From [url=https://www.teuton.org/~stranger/cms.mees-adventure]Official site[/url]]
